name: Nightmare
description: Fear, Terror, Illusion, The Subconscious, Void.

cost.text: Every time you apply a Nightmare Verum Effect, you make a Dream saving throw — DC 10, +2 for each use since your last long rest, +5 in Insomnia. On a failure you gain 1 level of Dream Exhaustion. Past your Proficiency Bonus in uses per long rest, you gain the level automatically.
cost.card: Each use: Dream save DC 10 (+2 per use since your long rest, +5 in Insomnia) or gain 1 Dream Exhaustion · past {PB} uses, you gain it automatically

offensive.name: Void-Bleed
offensive.description: You tear open the fragile membrane between sanity and oblivion.

tiers.text: The damage is turned into Absolute Void from the first tier, and it ignores resistance and immunity altogether — it strikes soul, dream-form, and body alike. A creature that is hit or fails cannot regain hit points until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: Damage becomes ABSOLUTE VOID — ignores resistance and immunity entirely · no healing until the end of their next turn

tiers.text: Soul Erosion. Its maximum hit points are reduced by the Void damage dealt, until it finishes a long rest in its own Dream Node, or is restored by Greater Restoration or Wish.
tiers.card: Soul Erosion — their max HP drops by the Void damage until a long rest (in their own Node) or Greater Restoration

mech.maxHP: reduced by the Void damage dealt

tiers.text: The Void touches its mind: it gains 1 level of Dream Exhaustion.
tiers.card: They also gain 1 level of Dream Exhaustion

tiers.text: Its soul comes loose. It loses one feature of your choice — a trait, a spell, or a legendary action — for 1 minute, and its soul is left unstable: open to banishment, soul theft, or full dream severance. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this effect falls into a coma nothing short of Wish or divine aid can wake it from — and in Insomnia, it is erased from the dream.
tiers.card: Loses a feature of your choice for 1 min · soul unstable · dropped to 0: a coma only Wish wakes — erased, in Insomnia

offensive.name: Eat the Canvas
offensive.description: They are not here to feast on your flesh. They are here to burn your canvas.

tiers.text: The damage is turned into Void damage, and the Nightmare drinks from the well of the target's imagination. A creature that fails loses any Inspiration it holds and cannot gain more until the end of its next turn, and you gain temporary hit points equal to your Verum Modifier.
tiers.card: Damage becomes Void · they lose their Inspiration and can't gain any until the end of their next turn · you gain {VM} temp HP

tiers.text: It stops creating. Until the end of its next turn it cannot cast illusion, conjuration, or summoning spells, nor draw Creation seals — there is nothing left in it to make things with.
tiers.card: Until the end of their next turn: no illusion, conjuration or summoning spells, and no Creation seals

tiers.text: The well runs lower. Until the end of its next turn it cannot use its single most powerful option — its highest remaining spell slot, a recharge ability, or a legendary action, your choice.
tiers.card: Until the end of their next turn they can't use their strongest option — top spell slot, a recharge ability, or a legendary action

suppress.duration: until the end of their next turn

tiers.text: Colorless. For 1 minute the creature is Hollowed: it cannot take reactions or bonus actions, and on each of its turns it may only take an action it has already taken during this fight. It leaves no silence behind — only stagnation.
tiers.card: Hollowed 1 min — no reactions or bonus actions, and it can only repeat actions it has already taken this fight

supportive.name: Dreamborn
supportive.description: Only what is dreamed can harm what dreams.

tiers.text: The target has already seen worse. It cannot be Frightened, and it has advantage on Dream saving throws.
tiers.card: Can't be Frightened · advantage on Dream saves

tiers.text: It wears a Nightmare's senses: blindsight out to 30 feet, and resistance to psychic damage.
tiers.card: Blindsight 30 ft · resistance to psychic damage

tiers.text: Dreamborn Resilience. It has resistance to all damage except damage dealt by a Dreamlike or Lucidlike item, a Cognition-infused spell or seal, or an attack with the Paradox property.
tiers.card: Resistant to ALL damage — except Dreamlike or Lucidlike items, Cognition-infused spells and seals, or Paradox

buff.resist: all damage except dreamlike, Cognition-infused or Paradox sources

tiers.text: It becomes a truth that must be feared. Creatures that can see it have disadvantage on attack rolls against it — their bodies refuse to close with what they recognize — and it cannot be Charmed, possessed, or have its mind read.
tiers.card: Creatures that see it attack it at disadvantage · can't be Charmed, possessed or mind-read

buff.defense: disadvantage on attacks from creatures that can see it

control.name: Truth of Terror
control.description: You plunge into a creature's soul and open the cellar door it has locked shut.

tiers.text: A creature that fails reveals one fear to you — a phobia, a trauma, or a target — and is Frightened until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: You learn one of their fears · Frightened until the end of their next turn

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.duration: until the end of their next turn

tiers.text: You reshape the battlefield to match that fear — illusions and environmental mimicry across the seal's area. While it is inside the altered zone, it has disadvantage on Dream saving throws.
tiers.card: The area becomes their fear · inside it they have disadvantage on Dream saves

penalty.disadvantage: Dream saving throws inside the altered zone

tiers.text: You mark it with its own fear. Your allies have advantage on attack rolls against it, and at the start of each of its turns it repeats the Dream saving throw — on a failure it is Incapacitated by hallucinations for that turn.
tiers.card: Allies attack it with advantage · each turn it starts: Dream save or Incapacitated by hallucinations that turn

penalty.defense: allies have advantage on attacks against it

tiers.text: Extract the fear itself as a crystallized concept — a Vil Memory Shard. You may hold one at a time. It can serve as a free component for a future Nightmare effect, be implanted to anchor a Nightmare Node, or be consumed to deal 15d10 Void damage to a creature you can see and inflict 1 level of Madness.
tiers.card: Extract a Vil Memory Shard (hold one) — a free component, a Node anchor, or consume it for 15d10 void and 1 Madness

control.name: Waking Horror
control.description: The boundary between nightmare and waking collapses — and they are alone inside it.

tiers.text: A creature that fails cannot tell illusion from reality until the end of its next turn: it must treat every creature as potentially hostile, and cannot benefit from the Help action or from flanking.
tiers.card: Can't tell illusion from reality until the end of their next turn — everyone looks hostile, no Help or flanking

tiers.text: It is trapped in a waking nightmare. At the start of each of its turns while the effect holds, it repeats the Dream saving throw — on a failure it is Stunned for that turn as the hallucinations overwhelm it; a success ends the effect.
tiers.card: Trapped — each turn: Dream save or Stunned that turn · a success ends it

tiers.text: The waking nightmare sustains itself. A success now only reduces Stunned to Frightened for that turn, and the effect ends only after two consecutive successes. While it holds, magical healing cannot raise the creature above half its maximum hit points.
tiers.card: Self-sustaining — a success only makes it Frightened instead · ends after two successes in a row · healing capped at half max HP

tiers.text: Once per long rest, collapse a creature's sense of self entirely. On a failure it is Incapacitated and Frightened for 1 minute, believing itself trapped in Insomnia, and at the end of each of its turns it repeats the Dream saving throw or gains 1 level of Dream Exhaustion. Only Greater Restoration or divine intervention ends it early.
tiers.card: 1/long rest — Incapacitated and Frightened 1 min, lost in Insomnia · each turn: Dream save or 1 Dream Exhaustion

control.name: Corrupt the Familiar
control.description: You force the familiar into the grotesque — turning what was once a guardian into a horror.

tiers.text: This seal reaches the dreamed and the called: Denizens, spirits, conjured dreamforms, and any creature summoned or conjured by magic. One that fails turns Feral until the end of its next turn, attacking the nearest creature regardless of allegiance.
tiers.card: Denizens, spirits and summoned creatures: Feral until the end of their next turn — they attack whoever is nearest

conditions.name: Feral
conditions.duration: until the end of their next turn

tiers.text: One that fails is transformed into a Demi-Nightmare for 1 minute — its CR one higher than before, and hostile to every creature.
tiers.card: Turned into a Demi-Nightmare for 1 min — CR +1, hostile to everyone

tiers.text: The transformation becomes permanent unless purified by a divine Cognition or Nightmare Purification: it becomes a Nightling bound to no master — a summoned creature breaks free of whoever called it.
tiers.card: Permanent — a masterless Nightling unless purified · summoned creatures break free of their summoner

tiers.text: You may now target any sentient Denizen or Dreamer. One that fails is fully overwritten into a Primal Nightmare, with corruption auras and a tether to your Node. You may summon or banish it at will, once per day.
tiers.card: Now any sentient Denizen or Dreamer — overwritten into a Primal Nightmare tethered to your Node, called or banished once a day

summon.uses: summon or banish once per day

creation.name: Nightmare Seed
creation.description: You spawn a horror forged from the raw marrow of Insomnia.

tiers.text: What you make is made of dread. A Construct is a Demi-Nightmare, wearing whatever shape the nearest enemy fears, and its attacks deal Void damage. A creature that touches or strikes one of your Structures relives a fear and has disadvantage on its next attack roll. Objects you make are Fear Grafts: a creature hit by one takes an extra 1d6 psychic damage.
tiers.card: Constructs are Demi-Nightmares shaped like the nearest enemy's fear, dealing Void · touch a Structure: disadvantage on their next attack · Objects are Fear Grafts, +1d6 psychic

tiers.text: A Nightling. You may design your Construct from the fears of one creature you can see — it has advantage on attack rolls against that creature.
tiers.card: Build a Nightling from one creature's fears — advantage on its attacks against that creature

summon.advantage: attacks against the creature it was made from

tiers.text: A Hollowborn. Your Construct may instead be a sentient, psychic duplicate of a creature's worst memory: once while it lasts, it can use one spell or feature that creature knows, with that creature's numbers.
tiers.card: Or a Hollowborn — a creature's worst memory made sentient · once, it can use one of that creature's spells or features

summon.borrow: one spell or feature of the source creature, once

tiers.text: A Primal Nightmare, forged from your Node and bound to your will. Choose three traits: Unnerving Presence (enemies within 10 feet have disadvantage on saves), Phase Body (moves through creatures and objects, resistant to nonmagical damage), Voidflame (its attacks deal an extra 2d10 Void), Dreamleech (regains hit points equal to half the damage it deals), or Paradox Form (ignores all resistances). It outlasts the seal and remains until destroyed or banished — you may have only one.
tiers.card: A Primal Nightmare with three traits — Unnerving Presence, Phase Body, Voidflame, Dreamleech, Paradox Form · it stays until destroyed (one at a time)

utility.name: Beneath the Dream
utility.description: Every sleeper keeps a door they do not open. You have the key to all of them.

tiers.text: Look at a creature and know the fear it keeps nearest the surface. Look at a Nightmare and know the Vile Emotion at its root. Sense any Nightmare, and any Node that has fallen to one, within a mile.
tiers.card: Know a creature's surface fear · know a Nightmare's root Vile Emotion · sense Nightmares within a mile

tiers.text: Enter the dream of a sleeping creature within 60 feet and turn it: it wakes having gained no benefit from its rest, and with 1 level of Dream Exhaustion.
tiers.card: Turn a sleeper's dream within 60 ft into a nightmare — no benefit from the rest, and 1 Dream Exhaustion

tiers.text: Walk Insomnia. Incept into any Node you have seen, and a Nightmare's Reality Lock does not raise your Incept DCs.
tiers.card: Incept into any Node you've seen · a Nightmare's Reality Lock doesn't touch your Incept DCs

tiers.text: Be believed in. Tonight every sleeper within a mile dreams of you: you may speak into every one of those dreams at once, and you learn the single fear each of them holds most tightly.
tiers.card: Every sleeper within a mile dreams of you tonight — speak into all their dreams, and learn each one's deepest fear

complementEffects.name: Void Touch
complementEffects.description: The seal carries a trace of what lives beneath the world.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw against the primary effect, half of the damage dealt becomes Void damage — it cannot be resisted or ignored by immunity, so a creature resistant or immune to the original type still takes the Void portion in full.
effect.card: Half the damage becomes Void — it ignores resistance and immunity

mech.pierce: resistance and immunity, on the Void portion

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Two-thirds of the damage becomes Void, and the target cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn.
upgrades.card: Two-thirds becomes Void · no healing until the start of your next turn

upgrades.text: Level 11+: All of the damage becomes Void, and a target that fails also gains 1 level of Dream Exhaustion as the Void brushes its mind.
upgrades.card: All of it becomes Void · a failed save also brings 1 Dream Exhaustion

complementEffects.name: Dread Mantle
complementEffects.description: Nightmare's presence becomes a shield for those who walk inside it.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, a Dread Mantle settles over you for 1 minute: allies within 15 feet of you cannot be Frightened and have advantage on Dream saving throws. The dread wears on you as well — until it lifts, you have disadvantage on Wisdom checks.
effect.card: 1 min: allies within 15 ft can't be Frightened, advantage on Dream saves — but you have disadvantage on Wisdom checks

cost.checks: disadvantage on your Wisdom checks for 1 minute

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The radius becomes 30 feet, and allies inside also have resistance to psychic damage.
upgrades.card: 30 ft · allies inside also resist psychic damage

upgrades.text: Level 11+: The cost is gone, and enemies that start their turn inside the mantle have disadvantage on attack rolls against the creatures it protects until the start of their next turn.
upgrades.card: No more cost · enemies starting a turn inside it attack the protected at disadvantage

penalty.disadvantage: enemies' attacks against those inside the mantle

effect.text: When the primary effect hits or a target fails its saving throw, a psychic echo lodges in its mind: it is Haunted for 1 minute. While Haunted it has disadvantage on Dream saving throws and cannot willingly move closer to you.
effect.card: Haunted 1 min — disadvantage on Dream saves, and they can't willingly move closer to you

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The echo whispers. The Haunted creature has disadvantage on Concentration checks, and whenever it casts a spell with a verbal component it must succeed on a Dream saving throw or the echo steals the words and the spell fails.
upgrades.card: Disadvantage on Concentration · each spoken spell: Dream save or the echo steals the words and it fails

upgrades.text: Level 11+: The Haunt no longer fades after 1 minute — only Remove Curse or Greater Restoration ends it — and once per round the DM may have it surface a fear, Frightening the creature for 1 turn with no save.
upgrades.card: Permanent until Remove Curse or Greater Restoration · once a round it may surface a fear — Frightened 1 turn, no save

conditions.name: Haunted
conditions.duration: until Remove Curse or Greater Restoration
